description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ascii字符。
description.en: A unique token generated by the client to guarantee the idempotency of the request. The maximum length is 64 ASCII characters.

title.zh: 更新指定实例的访问白名单
title.en: Update the access whitelist of a specified instance

descriptions.zh:
## 注意事项
- 实例状态为生效中（activating）、失效（invalid）和冻结（inactive），无法更新信息。
- 您可以通过两种方式更新白名单：IP白名单列表和IP白名单组。两种方式不能同时使用，且除了InstanceId和clientToken外，两种方式支持配置的参数也不同，具体如下：
    - IP白名单列表：whiteIpList、nodeType、networkType
    - IP白名单组：modifyMode、whiteIpGroup
- 公网访问白名单不支持配置私网IP地址，私网访问白名单不支持配置公网IP地址。
descriptions.en:
## Before you begin
- You cannot update information for an instance whose instance status is activating, invalid, or freeze (inactive).
- You can update the whitelist in two ways: IP whitelist list and IP whitelist group. The two methods cannot be used at the same time. In addition to InstanceId and clientToken, the two methods support different parameters:
    - IP whitelist list: whiteIpList, nodeType, networkType
    - IP whitelist group: modifyMode, whiteIpGroup
- The public network access whitelist does not support private network IP addresses, and the internal-facing whitelist does not support public IP addresses.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch modify-white-ips --instance-id es-cn-0pp1jxvcl000z0000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --node-type WORKER --network-type PUBLIC --modify-mode Cover --white-ip-list 192.168.xx.xx --white-ip-group '{"groupName":"test_group","whiteIpType":"PRIVATE_ES","ips":["192.168.xx.xx"]}' --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
